about:
Virginia Panel Corporation (VPC) is headquartered in Waynesboro, Virginia. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

VPC manufactures cable assemblies and interconnect solutions for test and measurement applications. Its product line includes discrete-wired cable assemblies that incorporate proprietary VPC modules with customer-specified connectors, as well as slide-off backshells designed for easy wiring access during maintenance and probing. The company also provides digital engineering tools such as a Wirelist Template for communicating project requirements, a Cable Solution Selector that matches PXI instruments with VPC receivers, and a Patchcord Designer supporting over 70 contact and patchcord combinations. These tools are intended to accelerate quoting, reduce errors, and lower labor costs.

The company serves customers in the automotive, aerospace, defense, medical, and telecommunications sectors. Its solutions are used in applications including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, ECU testing, signal conditioning, RF and microwave testing, and environmental testing. VPC’s interconnect products align with industry standards such as PXI, VXI, VDATS, and CASS.

VPC emphasizes that its engineering team and digital toolset are designed to decrease quote and order turnaround times, reduce the risk of human error, and save customers time and money. The firm positions its combination of manufactured interconnect hardware and configuration software as a way to streamline the connection between test instruments and receivers.
